name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 162 drones overnight to 10 Nov; talks open
summary: Russia launched 162 drones and a missile overnight to 10 Nov; US-mediated talks opened in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched an Iskander-M missile and 162 drones from the evening of 9 Nov, with 135 drones downed and hits at 19 locations (Ukrinform). This follows 317 drones overnight to 9 Nov and the Zaporizhzhia plant's loss of all off-site power on 8 Nov, the safety incident that sets the Alert (Moscow Times). Trilateral talks with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner began in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov, the first since February, with security guarantees central (The National).
for_you: Air and drone strikes on Ukraine's energy grid continue and talks have only just begun. Anyone with links to Ukraine or neighbouring states should follow FCDO travel advice; energy markets remain sensitive to strikes on refineries and power sites.
rubric_hit: Nuclear-plant safety incident: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power on 8 Nov; mass drone strikes on the grid
